sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Whenever Darren Lopez heard the song What Might Have Been by country music band Little Texas, his mind wandered and he began to reminisce.
sentences.zh: 每当达伦·洛佩兹听到乡村乐队“小德克萨斯”演唱的《曾经可能》（What Might Have Been）时，他的思绪就会飘远，开始陷入回忆。

sentences.en: In the song, the narrator laments to a former romantic partner about the fact that he cannot
sentences.zh: 歌中，叙述者向曾经的恋人感叹，他无法

sentences.en: change the past, and there's no way of knowing what their relationship might have become.
sentences.zh: 改变过去，也无从知晓他们之间的关系本可能走向何方。

sentences.en: Darren was drawn to the thoughtful lyrics, which included lines like We could sit and talk about this all night long and wonder why we didn't laSt.
sentences.zh: 达伦被这些深情的歌词所吸引，其中写道：“我们可以彻夜长谈，感叹为何我们没能走到最后。”

sentences.en: Yes, they might be the best days we will ever know, but we'll have to leave them in the paSt.
sentences.zh: “是的，那或许是我们所能拥有的最美好的时光，但我们终究要将它们留在过去。”

sentences.en: Darren first heard What Might Have Been in 1996 after returning home from military deployment in South
sentences.zh: 达伦第一次听到《曾经可能》是在1996年，当时他刚从韩国的

sentences.en: Korea.
sentences.zh: 军事部署中退役回家。

sentences.en: The song evoked happy memories of his youth in Arizona, specifically of his high school sweetheart, Jennifer Nichols.
sentences.zh: 这首歌唤起了他在亚利桑那州度过的快乐青春时光，尤其是关于他高中时的恋人詹妮弗·尼科尔斯的回忆。

sentences.en: The pair had met when they were both 15 in their school's jazz band and maintained a mutual friendship for several years until a three-week-long school trip to Europe
sentences.zh: 两人15岁时在学校爵士乐队相识，并保持了多年的纯友谊，直到一次为期三周的学校欧洲之旅

sentences.en: brought them closer together.
sentences.zh: 拉近了他们的距离。

sentences.en: By the end of that first week, Darren and Jennifer were officially boyfriend and girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 那次旅行的第一周结束时，达伦和詹妮弗正式确立了男女朋友关系。

sentences.en: They shared their first kiss under the Eiffel Tower.
sentences.zh: 他们在埃菲尔铁塔下分享了初吻。

sentences.en: From then on, the pair were inseparable.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，两人形影不离。

sentences.en: Jennifer admired Darren's politeness, his organisational skills, and the way he made her feel so safe.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗钦佩达伦的礼貌、组织能力，以及他带给她的那种极大的安全感。

sentences.en: They attended prom together, Jennifer in a sleeveless red dress and Darren in a suit with a red bow tie to match.
sentences.zh: 他们一起参加了毕业舞会，詹妮弗穿着一件无袖红裙，达伦则系着与之相配的红色领结。

sentences.en: As they entered college, they shared hopes that they would one day marry.
sentences.zh: 进入大学后，他们曾共同憧憬着有朝一日能步入婚姻殿堂。

sentences.en: But it wasn't meant to be.
sentences.zh: 但事与愿违。

sentences.en: Darren dropped out and followed in his father's footsteps by joining the army.
sentences.zh: 达伦中途辍学，追随父亲的脚步加入了军队。

sentences.en: Jennifer opted to stay put and continue pursuing her education in health sciences.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗则选择留在原地，继续攻读健康科学专业。

sentences.en: In 1993, as their paths in life naturally deviated, the pair amicably split.
sentences.zh: 1993年，随着人生道路的自然分叉，两人友好地分手了。

sentences.en: Years passed with no contact between them.
sentences.zh: 多年过去，他们之间没有任何联系。

sentences.en: Yet, any time Darren heard what might have been, his thoughts turned to Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 然而，每当达伦听到《曾经可能》这首歌，他的思绪总会转向詹妮弗。

sentences.en: He wondered where she was, what she was doing, and who she might be with.
sentences.zh: 他好奇她身在何处，在做什么，又和谁在一起。

sentences.en: Most of all, he truly wished her the beSt.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他真心希望她一切都好。

sentences.en: 2019 wasn't a good year for Darren Lopez.
sentences.zh: 2019年对达伦·洛佩兹来说并不是顺遂的一年。

sentences.en: He had separated from his wife, lost touch with friends, and barely had any contact with anyone.
sentences.zh: 他与妻子分居，与朋友断了联系，几乎不与任何人往来。

sentences.en: He was never big on technology and had forgotten the passwords to his long-neglected social media accounts.
sentences.zh: 他从不热衷于科技产品，甚至忘记了那些早已荒废的社交媒体账号密码。

sentences.en: His daughters were mostly grown up and off experiencing life.
sentences.zh: 他的女儿们大多已经长大成人，在外闯荡。

sentences.en: The younger ones split their time between Darren and his ex-wife, though spent most of their time with their mother.
sentences.zh: 年纪较小的几个孩子在达伦和前妻之间轮流居住，但大部分时间还是和母亲在一起。

sentences.en: On New Year's Eve, Darren resolved to spend 2020 getting back into life and reconnecting with people.
sentences.zh: 除夕夜，达伦下定决心要在2020年重拾生活，重新与人建立联系。

sentences.en: Then, the COVID-19 pandemic hit.
sentences.zh: 随后，新冠疫情爆发了。

sentences.en: As lockdowns, quarantines, travel, and social restrictions were deployed across the country, Darren grappled with severe loneliness and depression on his isolated ranch.
sentences.zh: 随着全国范围内实施封锁、隔离、旅行和社交限制，达伦在他那偏僻的牧场里饱受孤独和抑郁的折磨。

sentences.en: The darker his thoughts became, the more importance he placed on achieving his New Year's resolution by any means possible.
sentences.zh: 他的思绪越是阴暗，他就越执着于不惜一切代价实现自己的新年愿望。

sentences.en: Darren turned to the internet to reach out to those he genuinely cared for but hadn't seen or heard from in a while.
sentences.zh: 达伦开始上网，试图联系那些他真心在乎，却已许久未见或未闻音讯的人。

sentences.en: One was his high school girlfriend, Jennifer Nichols.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是他的高中女友詹妮弗·尼科尔斯。

sentences.en: Having lost touch after their breakup in college, Darren was curious to know what Jennifer was up to.
sentences.zh: 大学分手后两人便失去了联系，达伦很想知道詹妮弗近况如何。

sentences.en: After all, she had never been far from his mind.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，她从未真正离开过他的心头。

sentences.en: While in the military, Darren had to provide top-secret information that could help confirm his identity if he was ever taken hostage by the enemy.
sentences.zh: 在军队服役期间，达伦必须提供一些绝密信息，以便在万一被敌方俘虏时确认身份。

sentences.en: The information had to be extremely personal and couldn't be easily uncovered online or obtained from anyone else.
sentences.zh: 这些信息必须极其私密，不能轻易在网上查到，也不能从其他人那里获取。

sentences.en: In turn, Darren disclosed fond memories he had of Jennifer Nichols, memories that no one else knew about.
sentences.zh: 于是，达伦披露了他与詹妮弗·尼科尔斯之间珍贵的回忆，这些回忆除了他们无人知晓。

sentences.en: Retaining this information during his two decades of active service was paramount for his day-to-day survival.
sentences.zh: 在二十年的现役生涯中，牢记这些信息对他日常的生存至关重要。

sentences.en: It became ingrained in him and profoundly meaningful.
sentences.zh: 这已成为他根深蒂固的一部分，意义深远。

sentences.en: In 2020, Darren searched social media until he believed he had finally tracked Jennifer down on business and employment website LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 2020年，达伦在社交媒体上搜索，直到他认为自己终于在商务社交网站LinkedIn上找到了詹妮弗。

sentences.en: She was no longer Jennifer Nichols, but Jennifer Faith.
sentences.zh: 她不再是詹妮弗·尼科尔斯，而是詹妮弗·费思。

sentences.en: On Tuesday March 17, Darren sent Jennifer a brief message reintroducing himself.
sentences.zh: 3月17日星期二，达伦给詹妮弗发了一条简短的信息，重新介绍了自己。

sentences.en: He received a response within the hour which read,
sentences.zh: 他在一小时内收到了回复，上面写着：

sentences.en: Hi Darren.
sentences.zh: “嗨，达伦。”

sentences.en: Wow, was I surprised to hear from you.
sentences.zh: “哇，收到你的消息我太惊讶了。”

sentences.en: I hope you understand if I am a bit skittish in responding.
sentences.zh: “希望你能理解，我回复得有些迟疑。”

sentences.en: How do I know this is really you?
sentences.zh: “我怎么确定这真的是你？”

sentences.en: Darren was elated.
sentences.zh: 达伦欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: He responded,
sentences.zh: 他回复道：

sentences.en: Would it help if I called you Angel?
sentences.zh: “如果我叫你‘天使’，你会相信吗？”

sentences.en: This was the special nickname he'd given Jennifer during the time they were together.
sentences.zh: 这是他当年和詹妮弗在一起时给她取的专属昵称。

sentences.en: He signed off with the quote,
sentences.zh: 他在结尾引用了一句话：

sentences.en: As you wish, which was a line from the 1987 film The Princess Bride, a movie they'd bonded over in the paSt.
sentences.zh: “如你所愿。”这是1987年电影《公主新娘》中的台词，那部电影曾是他们共同的美好回忆。

sentences.en: Jennifer's response was swift.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗很快回了信。

sentences.en: Yep, that did it.
sentences.zh: “没错，就是这个。”

sentences.en: Send me an email and let me know how you are.
sentences.zh: “给我发封邮件，告诉我你过得怎么样。”

sentences.en: Excited to talk to you.
sentences.zh: “很高兴能和你聊天。”

sentences.en: Darren sent Jennifer a lengthy email filling her in on the past three decades of his life.
sentences.zh: 达伦给詹妮弗发了一封长邮件，向她讲述了自己过去三十年的生活。

sentences.en: He thanked Jennifer for teaching him to braid hair as the skill had endeared him to his daughters and their friends.
sentences.zh: 他感谢詹妮弗教会他编辫子，因为这项技能让他赢得了女儿们及其朋友的喜爱。

sentences.en: Darren admitted,
sentences.zh: 达伦坦言：

sentences.en: You have no idea how much I have thought of you over the years.
sentences.zh: “你无法想象这些年来我有多想你。”

sentences.en: He encouraged Jennifer to look up the song What Might Have Been by Little Texas as it made him think of her and always put a smile on his face.
sentences.zh: 他鼓励詹妮弗去听听“小德克萨斯”乐队的《曾经可能》，说这首歌让他想起她，总能让他会心一笑。

sentences.en: Jennifer responded,
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗回复道：

sentences.en: Wow, my head has been swimming since I read your email this morning.
sentences.zh: “哇，自从今天早上读了你的邮件，我的脑子就一直乱哄哄的。”

sentences.en: You made my day, month, year, and possibly decade in reaching out to me and saying such nice things.
sentences.zh: “你联系我并说了这么多好听的话，让我这一天、这一月、这一年，甚至这十年都变得无比美好。”

sentences.en: Jennifer revealed that she thought about Darren a lot and had searched for him over the years.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗透露，她也经常想起达伦，这些年来也曾搜索过他的消息。

sentences.en: All she'd been able to deduce was that he was married and lived in Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 她所能查到的只有他已婚且住在田纳西州。

sentences.en: You're a hard man to find, she wrote.
sentences.zh: “你真是个难找的人，”她写道。

sentences.en: There are no details out there about you.
sentences.zh: “网上关于你的信息少之又少。”

sentences.en: Jennifer told Darren that things hadn't been easy for her after their breakup.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗告诉达伦，分手后的日子对她来说并不容易。

sentences.en: After one failed marriage, she swiftly married the next man who came along, a decision she called a huge mistake, as it only lasted nine months.
sentences.zh: 在经历了一段失败的婚姻后，她很快嫁给了下一个追求者，她称那是一个巨大的错误，因为那段婚姻只维持了九个月。

sentences.en: As a single mother, she struggled physically, emotionally, and financially, while also completing her college studies and a burgeoning career as a therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 作为单身母亲，她在身体、情感和经济上都举步维艰，同时还要完成大学学业并开启治疗师的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Then she met her third husband, Jamie Faith, and her life greatly improved.
sentences.zh: 后来她遇到了第三任丈夫杰米·费思，生活才有了极大的改善。

sentences.en: Together with Jennifer's daughter, they formed a happy family.
sentences.zh: 他们和詹妮弗的女儿一起，组成了一个幸福的家庭。

sentences.en: Jennifer excelled in her career, and by 2020, she was overseeing therapy programs and assisting new hospital openings across the country.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗在事业上表现出色，到2020年，她已经开始负责治疗项目，并协助全国各地新医院的开业。

sentences.en: Her daughter was 22 years old and had just completed a master's degree, while Jamie was a big deal at American Airlines.
sentences.zh: 她的女儿今年22岁，刚拿到了硕士学位，而杰米在美国航空担任要职。

sentences.en: Jennifer sent Darren a candid, happy photo of herself, Jamie, and their daughter together, adding,
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗给达伦发了一张她、杰米和女儿在一起的坦率、幸福的照片，并补充道：

sentences.en: I have definitely missed you over the years, and there have been so many times I've wanted to talk to you.
sentences.zh: “这些年来我确实很想你，有很多次我都想和你谈谈。”

sentences.en: Thanks for being persistent in looking for me.
sentences.zh: “谢谢你一直坚持寻找我。”

sentences.en: Darren replied with a recent photo of himself, before confessing that ever since Jennifer had responded to his email, he couldn't get her off his mind.
sentences.zh: 达伦回复了一张自己的近照，并坦白说，自从詹妮弗回复了他的邮件，他就对她念念不忘。

sentences.en: The two continued sending each other long emails throughout the day and into the night, catching each other up on every aspect of their lives.
sentences.zh: 两人整天整夜地互发长邮件，交流着彼此生活的方方面面。

sentences.en: They eventually began reminiscing about their high school romance, at which point the tone of their correspondence became wistful and flirtatious.
sentences.zh: 他们最终开始回忆起高中的恋情，谈话的基调也变得伤感而暧昧。

sentences.en: Darren admitted that Jennifer was making him, feel like that teenage boy so many years ago, while she said she was completely giddy.
sentences.zh: 达伦承认詹妮弗让他感觉回到了多年前那个少年时代，而詹妮弗则说她感到无比兴奋。

sentences.en: By the next day, Darren was overwhelmed with feelings.
sentences.zh: 到了第二天，达伦被汹涌的情感淹没了。

sentences.en: He wrote an email to Jennifer calling their reunion a great love story.
sentences.zh: 他给詹妮弗写了一封邮件，称他们的重逢是一段伟大的爱情故事。

sentences.en: Not wanting her to slip away from him again, he declared,
sentences.zh: 他不希望她再次从自己身边溜走，于是宣称：

sentences.en: I am glad you have had Jamie in your life.
sentences.zh: “我很高兴你的生命中有杰米。”

sentences.en: It looks like you have made a great family and what you have is unique and special and I don't want to break that up.
sentences.zh: “看起来你拥有一个很棒的家庭，你们所拥有的东西是独特而特别的，我不想破坏它。”

sentences.en: That being said, I know my heart, and you still possess it.
sentences.zh: “话虽如此，我了解我的心，它依然属于你。”

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: “我爱你。”

sentences.en: Jennifer confided in Darren that her commitment to
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗向达伦吐露，她对

sentences.en: Jamie had waned in recent years due to a lack of affection.
sentences.zh: 杰米的承诺因近年来缺乏关爱而逐渐淡化。

sentences.en: Darren made it abundantly clear that he was willing to provide Jennifer with the intimacy and romance she desired, while taking things as slowly as she needed.
sentences.zh: 达伦明确表示，他愿意给予詹妮弗她所渴望的亲密与浪漫，同时也愿意按照她需要的节奏慢慢来。

sentences.en: Jennifer reciprocated Darren's feelings and within days of reconnecting, the pair began brainstorming a five year plan for a future together.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗回应了达伦的感情，在重新联系后的几天内，两人就开始构思未来五年的共同生活计划。

sentences.en: Jennifer and Darren traded cell phone numbers and as their contact continued, they agreed to permanently delete their texts.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗和达伦交换了手机号码，随着联系的深入，他们约定永久删除短信记录。

sentences.en: However, their email correspondence remained archived in Darren's inbox.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们的电子邮件往来却一直保存在达伦的收件箱里。

sentences.en: His ex-wife came across the emails while Darren was in custody awaiting trial for Jamie Faith's murder.
sentences.zh: 达伦因涉嫌谋杀杰米·费思被捕候审期间，他的前妻发现了这些邮件。

sentences.en: Shocked by what they contained, she immediately sent them to detectives fronting the Faith case.
sentences.zh: 她被邮件内容震惊，立即将其发送给了负责费思案的侦探。

sentences.en: By this point, Darren and
sentences.zh: 此时，达伦和

sentences.en: Jennifer's emotional affair had already been exposed.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗的精神出轨行为已经曝光。

sentences.en: While the emails didn't initially reveal anything investigators didn't already know, it was eye-opening to glimpse the intensity of the pair's mutual affection.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些邮件最初并未揭露调查人员尚未掌握的信息，但窥见两人之间深厚的情感强度还是让人大开眼界。

sentences.en: But, as detectives made their way through the emails, something caught their attention.
sentences.zh: 然而，当侦探们仔细研读这些邮件时，一些细节引起了他们的注意。

sentences.en: Three weeks after Jennifer and Darren reconnected, on the morning of Monday, April 6,
sentences.zh: 在詹妮弗和达伦重新联系三周后，即4月6日星期一的早上，

sentences.en: Jennifer sent an uncharacteristically short and sharp email.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗发来了一封异常简短且语气尖锐的邮件。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 内容如下：

sentences.en: I can tell Jamie is texting you.
sentences.zh: “我知道杰米在给你发短信。”

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: “对不起。”

sentences.en: Before Darren had time to respond,
sentences.zh: 在达伦来得及回复之前，

sentences.en: Jennifer sent a follow-up email saying, I love you.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗又发了一封后续邮件说：“我爱你。”

sentences.en: I am sorry this has become such a mess.
sentences.zh: “很抱歉事情变得如此混乱。”

sentences.en: We just need to get through today somehow.
sentences.zh: “我们只需要设法度过今天。”

sentences.en: Once Jamie starts to believe you're gone, it will be better.
sentences.zh: “一旦杰米开始相信你已经离开，情况就会好转。”

sentences.en: I don't know what he is saying, but whatever he is telling you, I am okay.
sentences.zh: “我不知道他在说什么，但无论他告诉你什么，我都没事。”

sentences.en: I can handle this if I don't lose you.
sentences.zh: “只要不失去你，我都能应付。”

sentences.en: Please talk to me.
sentences.zh: “请和我谈谈。”

sentences.en: I need you.
sentences.zh: “我需要你。”

sentences.en: Without access to the texts to fill in the gaps, investigators deduced that Jamie had likely messaged Darren after learning of the emotional affair.

sentences.zh: 我猜她是想保护杰米，而且在某种程度上可能在责怪自己。

sentences.zh: 达伦希望在罗伯的帮助下，詹妮弗能意识到她身边有更多支持者，并获得信心站出来为自己说话。

sentences.en: If not, Darren at least felt reassured that he wasn't the only one who knew about the abuse and Rob could take immediate action if things got worse.

sentences.en: Shortly after, Rob emailed Darren claiming he had called Jamie to confront him.

sentences.zh: 他们都详细描述了詹妮弗所面临的痛苦和折磨，但詹妮弗的邮件充满了痛苦和恐惧，而杰米的邮件则带有嘲讽，仿佛在挑衅达伦。

sentences.zh: 在一次特别可怕的袭击后，詹妮弗向达伦寻求支持。

sentences.zh: 她说杰米把她的头按在热水浴缸的水下，同时强迫她为他进行口交。

sentences.zh: 她失去了知觉，醒来时杰米正在给她做心肺复苏。

sentences.en: She lost consciousness and came to with Jamie performing CPR on her.
sentences.zh: 达伦恳求詹妮弗报警，但她继续拒绝，害怕如果她揭露杰米的罪行，杰米会对她和她的女儿做出什么事。

sentences.en: Darren implored Jennifer to go to the police, but she continued to refuse, fearful of what Jamie would do to both her and her daughter if she exposed his crimes.
sentences.zh: 随着2020年10月的临近，杰米给达伦发邮件说，他正在为他和詹妮弗即将到来的15周年纪念日计划一些特别的事情。

sentences.zh: 他说他非常享受那次差点致命的热水浴缸事件，所以他打算看看詹妮弗在热水浴缸里能应付多少个男人。

sentences.en: He said he enjoyed the near fatal hot tub incident so much that he was going to see how many men Jennifer could handle in the hot tub.
sentences.zh: 他已经安排了七个人准备进行这次袭击。

sentences.zh: 虽然调查人员最初推测达伦是被雇来杀杰米的，但这封邮件改变了他们的想法。

sentences.zh: 他们现在相信达伦的动机是出于保护詹妮弗的愿望。

sentences.en: It appeared that Darren Lopez wasn't a cold-blooded killer after all, but a desperate man driven to save a woman he loved.
sentences.zh: 看来达伦·洛佩兹并非冷血杀手，而是一个为了拯救心爱女人而走投无路的绝望男人。

sentences.en: What investigators couldn't quite get their heads around was that Jamie Faith
sentences.zh: 调查人员一直无法理解的是，杰米·费思

sentences.en: They wondered if everything everyone knew about Jamie Faith was completely wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们不禁怀疑，大家对杰米·费思的认知是否全都是错的。

sentences.zh: 调查人员找到了杰米的老友杰里米·格布勒，詹妮弗曾指控他在她遭受的多次性侵中扮演了角色。

sentences.zh: 杰里米对这些针对他的指控感到震惊。

sentences.en: He vehemently denied ever assaulting Jennifer, claiming he'd only ever had positive interactions with her.
sentences.zh: 他极力否认曾侵犯过詹妮弗，声称自己与她之间只有过积极的互动。

sentences.en: In fact, he was partially responsible for having set her and Jamie up in the first place, believing they were both good people who were perfect for one another.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他还是促成詹妮弗和杰米在一起的牵线人之一，因为他认为他们都是好人，天造地设。

sentences.en: Jeremy maintained that Jamie had been a courteous and compassionate man.
sentences.zh: 杰里米坚称杰米一直是个彬彬有礼且富有同情心的人。

sentences.en: In the many years they'd known each other, Jeremy had never once sensed anything sinister was going on behind the scenes of the Faith marriage.
sentences.zh: 在他们相识的多年里，杰里米从未察觉到费思夫妇的婚姻背后有什么不可告人的阴暗面。

sentences.en: Investigators looked into Jeremy's whereabouts over the weekends in mid-2020 where the sexual abuse of Jennifer was alleged to have taken place.
sentences.zh: 调查人员调查了杰里米在2020年中期周末的行踪，当时正是詹妮弗声称遭受性虐待的时间段。

sentences.en: Jeremy lived over 800 miles away in the state of Arizona and was ruled out of having collaborated in Jamie's alleged crimes.
sentences.zh: 杰里米住在800多英里外的亚利桑那州，因此排除了他参与杰米所谓罪行的嫌疑。

sentences.en: Jeremy was also one of the select few people who Jennifer had added to her group text message thread wherein she provided updates about Jamie's case.
sentences.zh: 杰里米也是詹妮弗在群聊中添加的少数几个人之一，她在群里更新关于杰米案件的进展。

sentences.en: Why would she do this if Jeremy was one of her feared abusers?
sentences.zh: 如果杰里米是她恐惧的施暴者之一，她为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Jennifer had also added her close co-worker Rob Schmidt to the group text.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗还将她亲密的同事罗布·施密特也加进了群聊。

sentences.en: When Rob was shown the emails sent between him and Darren, he was stunned.
sentences.zh: 当罗布看到他和达伦之间的邮件往来时，他惊呆了。

sentences.en: According to Rob, he hadn't written the emails details and had never even heard of Darren Lopez.
sentences.zh: 据罗布所说，他并没有写过这些邮件，甚至从未听说过达伦·洛佩兹这个人。

sentences.en: Inquiries were made with the email service provider.
sentences.zh: 调查人员向电子邮件服务提供商进行了查询。

sentences.en: They revealed that the email account attributed to Rob Schmidt had been created on the same day that
sentences.zh: 结果显示，那个归属于罗布·施密特的电子邮箱账号，创建于

sentences.zh: 达伦开始收到来自该地址邮件的同一天。

sentences.en: The same thing went for the email account attributed to Jamie Faith.
sentences.zh: 归属于杰米·费思的邮箱账号也是如此。

sentences.en: Both accounts were deleted at the same time on the same day, shortly before Jamie was murdered.
sentences.zh: 这两个账号都在杰米遇害前不久的同一天被同时注销了。

sentences.en: When Jennifer Faith had been charged with obstruction of justice following Darren's arrest, investigators carried out a search warrant on her home and serendipitously
sentences.zh: 在达伦被捕后，詹妮弗·费思因妨碍司法公正受到指控，调查人员对她的家执行了搜查令，并意外地

sentences.en: took possession of her computer.
sentences.zh: 查获了她的电脑。

sentences.en: An examination of Jennifer's inbox revealed a cache of emails sent between herself and Darren in which they discussed the abuse inflicted by Jamie.
sentences.zh: 对詹妮弗收件箱的检查揭露了一系列她与达伦之间往来的邮件，他们在邮件中讨论了杰米施加的虐待。

sentences.en: Investigators also found images of the injuries that had been sent to Darren as proof of Jamie's violence.
sentences.zh: 调查人员还发现了作为杰米暴力证据发送给达伦的伤情照片。

sentences.en: Some of the images were indeed of Jennifer, but they were found to have been taken eight years earlier and were the result of a car wreck.
sentences.zh: 其中一些照片确实是詹妮弗本人，但经查实是八年前拍摄的，且是一场车祸的结果。

sentences.en: Others, like the bloodied lip, were stock images
sentences.zh: 其他的，比如血淋淋的嘴唇，都是

sentences.zh: 詹妮弗从网上下载的库存图片。

sentences.en: The images allegedly depicting Jennifer's sexual abuse were also found to be stills from pornographic movies.
sentences.zh: 那些据称描绘詹妮弗遭受性虐待的照片，也被发现是色情电影的截图。

sentences.en: Jennifer's computer was sent to the
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗的电脑被送往

sentences.en: It turned out that

sentences.zh: 詹妮弗是所有发给达伦的邮件背后的唯一策划者，包括那些据称来自罗布·施密特和杰米·费思的邮件。

sentences.zh: 没有任何证据表明达伦和杰米之间有过真正的接触。

sentences.en: Jennifer was sending multiple emails to Darren each day from the fake accounts, while also pretending to be her own husband and maintaining round-the-clock communication
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗每天用虚假账号给达伦发送多封邮件，同时还要假扮成自己的丈夫，并以自己的身份

sentences.zh: 与达伦保持全天候的沟通。

sentences.en: They also found no evidence that

sentences.zh: 所有关于身体、情感和性虐待的故事都被认定为詹妮弗捏造的彻头彻尾的谎言。

sentences.en: And as it turned out, this wasn't the first time she'd done such a thing.
sentences.zh: 而且事实证明，这已经不是她第一次做这种事了。

sentences.en: Investigators discovered that Jennifer had a history of contacting ex-partners and telling them she was abused by a husband or boyfriend in order to provoke a reaction.
sentences.zh: 调查人员发现，詹妮弗有联系前任并谎称自己被丈夫或男友虐待以博取反应的前科。

sentences.en: Jennifer's second husband Rick told Dateline that he and Jennifer had originally started dating while she was separated from her first husband.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗的第二任丈夫里克告诉《日界线》，他和詹妮弗最初是在她与第一任丈夫分居期间开始约会的。

sentences.en: One day, Jennifer confided in Rick that her marriage had been hellish.
sentences.zh: 有一天，詹妮弗向里克吐露，她的婚姻简直是地狱。

sentences.zh: 她称丈夫为恶魔，说他对自己进行了身体、情感和性虐待。

sentences.en: Rick was shocked and encouraged Jennifer to go to the police, but she refused.
sentences.zh: 里克感到震惊，并鼓励詹妮弗报警，但她拒绝了。

sentences.en: Jennifer told Rick she wished her husband was dead.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗告诉里克，她希望她丈夫死掉。

sentences.en: As Jennifer continued to offload stories of her horrific abuse,
sentences.zh: 随着詹妮弗不断倾诉她遭受的可怕虐待故事，

sentences.zh: 里克发现自己也产生了想要杀死詹妮弗丈夫的念头。

sentences.en: He explained to Dateline,
sentences.zh: 他向《日界线》解释道：

sentences.zh: 这本来是她的主意，直到她让你以为这是你自己的主意。

sentences.en: But Jennifer had a last-minute change of heart, saying she didn't want her daughter's father dead.
sentences.zh: 但詹妮弗在最后一刻改变了主意，说她不想让女儿的父亲死掉。

sentences.en: She ultimately divorced her first husband and married Rick instead.
sentences.zh: 她最终与第一任丈夫离婚，转而嫁给了里克。

sentences.zh: 婚后不久，

sentences.zh: 詹妮弗是他接触过最邪恶的人，说和她在一起就像是在谎言、操纵和痛苦的海洋中游泳。

sentences.en: In contrast, Darren Lopez was a trained killer who could get the job done swiftly and discreetly without drawing any attention towards Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，达伦·洛佩兹是一名训练有素的杀手，能够迅速且隐秘地完成任务，而不会引起对詹妮弗的任何怀疑。

sentences.en: There was also another element that made Darren the ideal hitman.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个因素使达伦成为理想的雇佣杀手。

sentences.en: In one of his initial emails to Jennifer, Darren had written extensively about his experiences in the military.
sentences.zh: 在给詹妮弗的最初几封邮件中，达伦详细写到了他在军队的经历。

sentences.en: Specifically, the Humvee explosion in Iraq that left him with a traumatic brain injury and post-traumatic stress disorder.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，是他在伊拉克遭遇的悍马车爆炸事件，那次事件导致他患上了创伤性脑损伤和创伤后应激障碍。

sentences.zh: 这些信息立刻引起了詹妮弗的兴趣。

sentences.en: Through her work as a therapist, Jennifer told Darren that she had treated many patients with traumatic brain injuries over the years, many of whom were soldiers.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗利用她治疗师的身份告诉达伦，多年来她治疗过许多患有创伤性脑损伤的病人，其中许多是士兵。

sentences.en: She claimed to be a certified brain injury specialist who had written a number of articles for the Brain Injury Alliance of Arizona.
sentences.zh: 她自称是一名认证的脑损伤专家，曾为亚利桑那州脑损伤联盟撰写过文章。

sentences.en: Jennifer said she wanted to help Darren and convinced him to send her a copy of his medical records from the Department of Defense and the Department of Veteran Affairs.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗说她想帮助达伦，并说服他将国防部和退伍军人事务部的医疗记录副本发给她。

sentences.en: Over 912 pages, the reports disclosed that Darren also had a major depressive disorder, as well as attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
sentences.zh: 在912页的报告中，披露了达伦还患有重度抑郁症以及注意力缺陷多动障碍。

sentences.en: He also suffered from severe migraines, vision loss, ringing in his ears, dizziness, vertigo, nightmares, sleeping difficulties, and frightening flashbacks of combat.
sentences.zh: 他还遭受严重的偏头痛、视力丧失、耳鸣、头晕、眩晕、噩梦、睡眠困难以及可怕的战斗闪回困扰。

sentences.en: He was on various medications to treat these conditions, while neurological tests showed that he had performed below average on cognitive, attention, and memory function.
sentences.zh: 他服用各种药物来治疗这些疾病，而神经学测试显示他在认知、注意力和记忆功能方面的表现低于平均水平。

sentences.en: His PTSD could be triggered by stress or crowds, which then caused him to spiral emotionally.
sentences.zh: 他的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）可能会因压力或人群而触发，进而导致他情绪失控。

sentences.en: With Jennifer's knowledge of traumatic brain injuries, she was aware of the many challenges that patients faced.
sentences.zh: 凭借对创伤性脑损伤的了解，詹妮弗很清楚患者面临的许多挑战。

sentences.en: There were personality changes, behavioural issues, behavioural issues, memory lapses, difficulties processing profound emotions, and difficulties with decision making.
sentences.zh: 包括性格改变、行为问题、记忆缺失、处理深层情绪的困难以及决策困难。

sentences.en: Post-traumatic stress disorder can also alter the way a person's brain works, specifically the emotional core of the brain.
sentences.zh: 创伤后应激障碍也会改变一个人的大脑运作方式，特别是大脑的情绪核心。

sentences.en: Veterans with PTSD often endure irritability, hyperarousal, and aggression problems as they find it difficult to turn their brain off and relax.
sentences.zh: 患有PTSD的退伍军人经常忍受易怒、过度觉醒和攻击性问题，因为他们很难让大脑停下来放松。

sentences.en: Some feel like they are always on edge, enduring ongoing feelings of fear, horror, anger, guilt, and shame.
sentences.zh: 有些人感觉自己总是处于紧绷状态，持续忍受着恐惧、惊恐、愤怒、内疚和羞耻感。

sentences.en: They can also struggle to trust others, as they typically view the world through a negative lens.
sentences.zh: 他们也可能难以信任他人，因为他们通常戴着有色眼镜看待世界。

sentences.en: When their trauma is triggered, they often depersonalise and disassociate.
sentences.zh: 当他们的创伤被触发时，他们往往会产生人格解体和分离感。

sentences.en: These skills serve them well while surviving on the battlefield, but have devastating impacts in civilian life.
sentences.zh: 这些技能在战场上生存时很有用，但在平民生活中却会产生毁灭性的影响。

sentences.en: From Darren Lopez's medical records, it was clear he was a particularly vulnerable individual.
sentences.zh: 从达伦·洛佩兹的医疗记录来看，很明显他是一个特别脆弱的人。

sentences.en: He had been deemed fully disabled and was considered unfit to perform normally in society.
sentences.zh: 他已被认定为完全残疾，被认为不适合在社会中正常生活。

sentences.en: As soon as Jennifer learnt of Darren's condition, she leaned heavily into the affection he displayed towards her.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗一得知达伦的情况，就极力利用他对她表现出的爱慕。

sentences.en: Investigators believed she used these emotions to manipulate and exploit Darren, telling lie after lie about the horrific, fictitious abuse her husband was allegedly inflicting.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，她利用这些情感来操纵和剥削达伦，编造了一个又一个关于她丈夫据称施加的可怕、虚构虐待的谎言。

sentences.en: The stories Jennifer concocted were described by investigators as some of the most sadistic things you can possibly dream up.
sentences.zh: 调查人员形容詹妮弗编造的故事是你所能想象出的最残忍的事情之一。

sentences.en: It appeared that Jennifer had successfully tricked a disabled veteran into becoming her own personal assassin.
sentences.zh: 看来詹妮弗成功地诱骗了一名残疾退伍军人成为她个人的杀手。

sentences.en: All the while, she was living a double life, maintaining her seemingly happy marriage with
sentences.zh: 与此同时，她过着双重生活，维持着与杰米看似幸福的婚姻。

sentences.en: Jamie.
sentences.zh: 杰米。

sentences.en: In contrast to Jennifer's stories, it appeared Jamie had no idea she was engaging in an emotional affair.
sentences.zh: 与詹妮弗的故事相反，杰米似乎根本不知道她正在进行一段精神出轨。

sentences.en: While all this was going on, he remained at home with Jennifer and even took her on two trips interstate to visit his family.
sentences.zh: 在这一切发生的同时，他一直和詹妮弗待在家里，甚至还带她去州际旅行了两次去探望他的家人。

sentences.en: It was now clear that Jennifer's efforts to thwart her husband's murder investigation weren't to protect Darren, her daughter, or even Jamie.
sentences.zh: 现在很清楚，詹妮弗阻挠丈夫谋杀案调查的努力并不是为了保护达伦、她的女儿，甚至也不是为了杰米。

sentences.en: She was only ever protecting herself.
sentences.zh: 她自始至终都只是在保护她自己。

sentences.en: The question was, why did Jennifer want Jamie dead?
sentences.zh: 问题是，詹妮弗为什么要杰米死？

sentences.en: By all accounts, he had been a loving and supportive husband and father who provided Jennifer and her daughter with financial security and a happy home life.
sentences.zh: 据各方说法，他一直是一位充满爱心和支持的丈夫和父亲，为詹妮弗和她的女儿提供了经济保障和幸福的家庭生活。

sentences.en: Investigators wondered whether Jennifer thought the grass would be greener with Darren.
sentences.zh: 调查人员想知道，詹妮弗是否认为和达伦在一起会更好。

sentences.en: Perhaps she envisioned the two of them having a more exciting and attractive life.
sentences.zh: 也许她设想他们两人能过上更刺激、更吸引人的生活。

sentences.en: Or maybe it was all about money.
sentences.zh: 又或者，这一切都是为了钱。

sentences.en: Jamie had over a million dollars in life insurance, and retirement funds, which Jennifer was the beneficiary of.
sentences.zh: 杰米拥有超过一百万美元的人寿保险和退休基金，而詹妮弗是受益人。

sentences.en: Having access to this money also meant she could use Darren's financial dire straits to her own advantage.
sentences.zh: 拥有这些钱的使用权也意味着她可以利用达伦陷入经济困境的处境为自己谋利。

sentences.en: In the words of one US attorney,
sentences.zh: 用一位美国检察官的话说：

sentences.en: Jennifer Faith preyed on Darren Lopez's pocketbook to propel him to murder.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·费思利用达伦·洛佩兹的钱袋子诱使他去杀人。

sentences.en: Criminal prosecutors hoped they could get Darren Lopez to cooperate with them once he learned the truth about Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 刑事检察官希望在达伦·洛佩兹得知詹妮弗的真相后，能让他与他们合作。

sentences.en: However, when shown evidence of her extensive con, Darren had the opposite reaction.
sentences.zh: 然而，当向达伦展示她大规模欺诈的证据时，他的反应却截然相反。

sentences.en: He flat out refused to believe the allegations against Jennifer and remained convinced that Jamie Faith was an abuser.
sentences.zh: 他断然拒绝相信针对詹妮弗的指控，并坚信杰米·费思是个施暴者。

sentences.en: Darren didn't trust anyone but Jennifer and simply couldn't come to terms with the possibility that the whole ordeal had been a scam.
sentences.zh: 达伦除了詹妮弗谁也不信，根本无法接受整个事件是一场骗局的可能性。

sentences.en: Even his own court-appointed attorney struggled to get him to accept the truth of the matter.
sentences.zh: 即使是他自己的法庭指定律师也难以让他接受事实真相。

sentences.en: Darren stood by Jennifer, even when the extent of her deception was publicly exposed.
sentences.zh: 即使在詹妮弗的欺骗行径被公开曝光后，达伦依然支持她。

sentences.en: She had done well to muddy the waters by sending Darren a letter beforehand.
sentences.zh: 她事先给达伦写了一封信，成功地搅浑了水。

sentences.en: It began with the number 575, their secret code to confirm the letter was authentic.
sentences.zh: 信以数字575开头，这是他们确认信件真实性的秘密代码。

sentences.en: Jennifer wrote,
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗写道：

sentences.en: Just a quick note to say I never lied to you and I never sent you the emails from any account but mine, as me.
sentences.zh: 写这封简短的信是为了告诉你，我从未对你撒谎，也从未用除我之外的任何账号以我的名义给你发过邮件。

sentences.en: You once said you would never believe anything about me unless you heard it from me.
sentences.zh: 你曾经说过，除非亲耳听到我说，否则你绝不会相信关于我的任何事情。

sentences.en: I hope that's still true.
sentences.zh: 希望这句话依然算数。

sentences.en: There is a ton more I wish I could say, but I can't right now.
sentences.zh: 我还有很多话想说，但现在还不能说。

sentences.en: Soon.
sentences.zh: 很快。

sentences.en: Hopefully.
sentences.zh: 希望如此。

sentences.en: For six months, Darren refused to believe that Jennifer could have used him in such an abhorrent way.
sentences.zh: 六个月来，达伦拒绝相信詹妮弗会以如此卑劣的方式利用他。

sentences.en: He was convinced that the two were deeply in love and his hatred for Jamie was so pervasive and genuine it was impossible for Darren to view him any other way.
sentences.zh: 他深信两人坠入爱河，他对杰米的仇恨如此根深蒂固且真实，以至于达伦无法以任何其他方式看待他。

sentences.en: It took a difficult conversation with one of his daughters before Darren finally saw the light.
sentences.zh: 直到与他的一个女儿进行了一次艰难的谈话，达伦才终于看清了真相。

sentences.en: With the veil lifted, he agreed to finally tell investigators the full story.
sentences.zh: 随着迷雾散去，他终于同意向调查人员讲述全部经过。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Casefile继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: According to Darren Lopez, he never wanted to be a homewrecker.
sentences.zh: 据达伦·洛佩兹所说，他从未想过要破坏别人的家庭。

sentences.en: When he confessed his feelings to Jennifer within days of them reconnecting, he assured her that he was willing to take things slow out of respect for her family.
sentences.zh: 当他在重新联系上詹妮弗几天后向她表白时，他向她保证，出于对她家庭的尊重，他愿意慢慢来。

sentences.en: He didn't want Jennifer's daughter to think poorly of him or view him as the person responsible for breaking up their family.
sentences.zh: 他不希望詹妮弗的女儿对他有不好的看法，或者把他看作是拆散他们家庭的人。

sentences.en: Furthermore, from what Jennifer had initially told Darren, he thought Jamie sounded like a legitimately good guy and hoped they could become friends.
sentences.zh: 此外，根据詹妮弗最初告诉达伦的话，他觉得杰米听起来是个真正的好人，并希望他们能成为朋友。

sentences.en: Darren encouraged Jennifer to be honest with Jamie, even floating the idea that Jamie might agree to share Jennifer with him so neither man wound up heartbroken.
sentences.zh: 达伦鼓励詹妮弗对杰米诚实，甚至提出了杰米可能会同意与他分享詹妮弗的想法，这样两人都不会心碎。

sentences.en: It wasn't until Jennifer told Darren that she had come clean to Jamie about their emotional affair, that Darren's opinion of Jamie began to change.
sentences.zh: 直到詹妮弗告诉达伦她已经向杰米坦白了他们的精神出轨，达伦对杰米的看法才开始改变。

sentences.en: Jennifer reported back that
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗反馈说

sentences.en: Jamie had taken the news poorly.
sentences.zh: 杰米对这个消息反应很激烈。

sentences.en: He had become angry and violent, his abusive behaviour amplified by alcohol and cocaine.
sentences.zh: 他变得愤怒且暴力，酒精和可卡因加剧了他的虐待行为。

sentences.en: From then on, she constantly bombarded Darren with details about the horrific things Jamie subjected her to.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，她不断地向达伦轰炸关于杰米对她施加的可怕细节。

sentences.en: She called Darren at all hours of the night, depriving him of sleep as she cried about the latest abuse she'd endured.
sentences.zh: 她会在深夜给达伦打电话，让他无法入睡，哭诉着她所遭受的最新虐待。

sentences.en: In addition to the rapes, Jennifer claimed that Jamie kept her tied up in a closet, was restricting her diet and had once forcibly cut her hair off.
sentences.zh: 除了强奸，詹妮弗还声称杰米把她关在壁橱里，限制她的饮食，甚至曾经强行剪掉了她的头发。

sentences.en: These details, coupled with the emails Darren received from Rob Schmidt and Jamie Faith, made him sick.
sentences.zh: 这些细节，加上达伦从罗布·施密特和杰米·费思那里收到的邮件，让他感到恶心。

sentences.en: He felt like he was losing his mind.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己快要疯了。

sentences.en: While he wanted to alert the authorities, Jennifer made him swear not to.
sentences.zh: 虽然他想报警，但詹妮弗让他发誓绝对不能这么做。

sentences.en: If Darren ever told the police,
sentences.zh: 如果达伦向警方透露过什么，

sentences.en: Jennifer said she would deny everything.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗说她会全盘否认。

sentences.en: Darren gave his word that he wouldn't go behind her back, and in the military, word is everything.
sentences.zh: 达伦承诺过绝不会背着她行事，而在军队里，承诺就是一切。

sentences.en: In October 2020, Jennifer told Darren that she'd reached her breaking point.
sentences.zh: 2020年10月，詹妮弗告诉达伦，她已经忍无可忍了。

sentences.en: She confessed that she wanted Jamie dead and began brainstorming ways to kill him.
sentences.zh: 她坦白说想让杰米死，并开始策划杀害他的方法。

sentences.en: She considered poisoning him, but was worried what would happen to her and her daughter if she got caught.
sentences.zh: 她考虑过下毒，但担心如果被抓，自己和女儿会面临什么后果。

sentences.en: Darren was shocked by Jennifer's plan and didn't express any interest in getting involved.
sentences.zh: 达伦对詹妮弗的计划感到震惊，并表示毫无参与的兴趣。

sentences.en: He even tried to convince her to convince her to reconsider.
sentences.zh: 他甚至试图劝说她三思而后行。

sentences.en: In turn, Jennifer appealed to Darren's sense of duty and honour, commending his protective instincts.
sentences.zh: 反过来，詹妮弗诉诸达伦的责任感和荣誉感，赞扬了他的保护本能。

sentences.en: It was clear she was trying to get him to carry out the killing instead.
sentences.zh: 很明显，她是在试图诱导他去执行杀人任务。

sentences.en: Darren pondered the idea in a facetious and wishful manner while trying to convince
sentences.zh: 达伦以一种戏谑和异想天开的方式思考了这个想法，同时试图说服

sentences.en: Jennifer to simply leave Jamie.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗直接离开杰米。

sentences.en: She refused to do so, fearful that he would retaliate against her and or her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她拒绝了，担心杰米会报复她和她的女儿。

sentences.en: Darren invited the two women to come live with him in Tennessee, but Jennifer dismissed this possibility, saying that they had to stay in Texas for her daughter's work.
sentences.zh: 达伦邀请这对母女搬到田纳西州和他一起住，但詹妮弗排除了这种可能性，称她们必须留在德克萨斯州，因为她女儿的工作在那儿。

sentences.en: It was only when Darren received emails from Jamie warning him of his plans to orchestrate a hot tub of gang rape for his and
sentences.zh: 直到达伦收到杰米的邮件，警告他计划在他们和

sentences.en: Jennifer's 15th anniversary that Darren started seriously considering Jennifer's proposal.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗结婚15周年纪念日时策划一场“热水浴缸轮奸案”，达伦才开始认真考虑詹妮弗的提议。

sentences.en: Scared that Jennifer could be killed during this attack, which was planned for the weekend of Friday
sentences.zh: 由于害怕詹妮弗会在这次袭击中丧生（袭击计划在2020年10月9日星期五那个周末进行），

sentences.en: October 9 2020, Darren was left agonising over what to do.
sentences.zh: 达伦陷入了痛苦的挣扎，不知该如何是好。

sentences.en: He said he didn't settle on a decision until the day before, Thursday October 8.
sentences.zh: 他说直到前一天，即10月8日星期四，他才下定决心。

sentences.en: That day, Darren convinced himself that he needed to eliminate the threat to save Jennifer's life.
sentences.zh: 那天，达伦说服自己，为了挽救詹妮弗的生命，他必须消除这个威胁。

sentences.en: After promising Jennifer that she would never go through another bad weekend again, Darren set out for Texas.
sentences.zh: 在向詹妮弗保证她再也不会经历糟糕的周末后，达伦出发前往德克萨斯州。

sentences.en: The 10-hour drive gave Darren plenty of time to transition back into a military mindset.
sentences.zh: 10个小时的车程给了达伦充足的时间重新进入军事思维模式。

sentences.en: He hyped himself up, reminding himself over and over that he had to rescue Jennifer and her daughter from Jamie.
sentences.zh: 他不断给自己打气，反复提醒自己必须从杰米手中救出詹妮弗和她的女儿。

sentences.en: As he approached the Texas border, his emotions ramped up and he turned off his phone.
sentences.zh: 当他接近德克萨斯州边境时，他的情绪高涨，于是关掉了手机。

sentences.en: But once he reached Dallas, he became loSt. He drove helplessly among the unfamiliar dark roads with no idea where to go or what to do.
sentences.zh: 但一旦到达达拉斯，他就迷路了。他在陌生黑暗的道路上无助地开车，不知道该去哪里或该做什么。

sentences.en: Panicking as time was running out, the intense emotions triggered Darren's post-traumatic stress disorder and he had mental breakdown.
sentences.zh: 随着时间流逝，恐慌感袭来，强烈的情绪触发了达伦的创伤后应激障碍，他精神崩溃了。

sentences.en: Overwhelmed and spiralling, he had to pull over to get his bearings.
sentences.zh: 在不知所措和情绪失控的情况下，他不得不靠边停车以辨别方向。

sentences.en: As far as he knew, the love of his life was going to be attacked within hours.
sentences.zh: 据他所知，他一生挚爱的人将在几小时内遭到袭击。

sentences.en: His mind was flooded with thoughts of what she was about to endure and the possibility that she could be killed.
sentences.zh: 他的脑海里充满了她即将遭受的折磨以及她可能被杀的念头。

sentences.en: With Darren's stress levels peaking, he was plagued by visions of the loved ones he'd lost over the years.
sentences.zh: 随着达伦的压力达到顶峰，他被多年来失去的亲人的幻象所困扰。

sentences.en: There were his military comrades, a close friend who had taken his own life, and Darren's own granddaughter who had drowned while he was on deployment.
sentences.zh: 其中包括他的战友、一名自杀的挚友，以及达伦在服役期间溺水身亡的孙女。

sentences.en: Darren felt responsible for all these deaths as he wasn't able to prevent them.
sentences.zh: 达伦对所有这些死亡感到自责，因为他没能阻止它们。

sentences.en: He'd since told himself that if he was ever in a position to help somebody, he wouldn't hesitate.
sentences.zh: 此后他告诉自己，如果将来有机会帮助别人，他绝不会犹豫。

sentences.en: He remembered an old military saying,
sentences.zh: 他想起了一句古老的军事格言，

sentences.en: it's better to be judged by 12 than carried by 6.
sentences.zh: “宁愿被12个人审判，也不愿被6个人抬着走。”

sentences.en: In other words, it was better to face a jury than wind up in a casket.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，面对陪审团总比躺进棺材里要好。

sentences.en: Darren knew the only way he could get out of his predicament was to turn his phone back on so he could search for directions.
sentences.zh: 达伦知道，摆脱困境的唯一方法就是重新打开手机，以便搜索路线。

sentences.en: He knew this would leave a digital record of his whereabouts and potentially seal his fate, but he felt as though he had no other option.
sentences.zh: 他知道这会留下行踪的数字记录，并可能决定他的命运，但他觉得别无选择。

sentences.en: If he returned to Tennessee and Jennifer ended up dead, he wouldn't be able to live with himself.
sentences.zh: 如果他回到田纳西州而詹妮弗最终死了，他将无法原谅自己。

sentences.en: With that, Darren powered on his cell phone, searched online for South Waverley Drive and followed the map.
sentences.zh: 就这样，达伦打开了手机，在线搜索了南韦弗利大道，并按照地图行驶。

sentences.en: Once he reached the Faith's house, Darren turned his phone back off.
sentences.zh: 到达费斯家后，达伦再次关掉了手机。

sentences.en: He didn't want to storm the Faith's home and risk any collateral damage.
sentences.zh: 他不想强攻费斯家，以免造成任何附带伤害。

sentences.en: Jennifer had already informed him that the house to the right was vacant, so Darren headed there.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗之前告诉过他右边的房子是空置的，所以达伦就去了那里。

sentences.en: He positioned himself against the fence in reconnaissance mode and waited.
sentences.zh: 他以侦察姿态靠在栅栏上等待。

sentences.en: Jennifer had already told Darren that she and Jamie walked their dog Maggie every morning.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗之前告诉过达伦，她和杰米每天早上都会遛狗玛吉。

sentences.en: At daybreak, Darren listened until he heard the Faith's door open.
sentences.zh: 黎明时分，达伦一直听着，直到听到费斯家的门打开。

sentences.en: He then heard Jennifer's voice and saw her walk past with Maggie.
sentences.zh: 随后他听到了詹妮弗的声音，看到她带着玛吉走了过去。

sentences.en: It was the first time Darren had laid eyes on her since they dated 30 years prior.
sentences.zh: 这是达伦自30年前约会以来第一次见到她。

sentences.en: He then watched as Jamie walked casually by.
sentences.zh: 接着他看着杰米悠闲地走过。

sentences.en: Darren acted immediately, shooting Jamie three times in the chest and causing him to fall to the ground.
sentences.zh: 达伦立即采取行动，向杰米的胸部开了三枪，导致他倒在地上。

sentences.en: As a military medic, Darren knew the human body could survive significant trauma.
sentences.zh: 作为一名军医，达伦知道人体可以承受严重的创伤。

sentences.en: Even though he thought Jamie was a monster, he still didn't want him to suffer.
sentences.zh: 尽管他认为杰米是个恶魔，但他仍然不想让他受苦。

sentences.en: He stood over Jamie and shot him three times in the head before shooting him in the groin as payback for the sexual abuse he'd inflicted on
sentences.zh: 他站在杰米上方，对着他的头部开了三枪，然后又向他的腹股沟开了一枪，作为对他性虐待

sentences.en: Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗的报复。

sentences.en: Darren stole Jamie's wedding ring to make it look like a robbery gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 达伦偷走了杰米的结婚戒指，使其看起来像是一起抢劫未遂案。

sentences.en: He then launched an attack on Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 随后，他向詹妮弗发起了攻击。

sentences.en: Darren hadn't forewarned Jennifer of his intentions to do this because he wanted her reaction to be genuine.
sentences.zh: 达伦事先没有告知詹妮弗他的意图，因为他希望她的反应是真实的。

sentences.en: He thought this would add credibility to the staged robbery while also giving Jennifer plausible deniability.
sentences.zh: 他认为这会增加伪造抢劫案的可信度，同时也让詹妮弗有合理的推诿理由。

sentences.en: Darren knocked Jennifer to the ground, punching and slapping her before duct taping her hands together.
sentences.zh: 达伦将詹妮弗推倒在地，对她拳打脚踢，然后用胶带把她的手绑在一起。

sentences.en: It was the first time they had touched since 1993.
sentences.zh: 这是他们自1993年以来第一次身体接触。

sentences.en: Jennifer's blood-curdling screams made Darren sick.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗那令人毛骨悚然的尖叫声让达伦感到恶心。

sentences.en: He tried to pull off her wedding ring, but it got stuck.
sentences.zh: 他试图摘下她的结婚戒指，但戒指卡住了。

sentences.en: That's when he noticed a witness rushing over.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，他注意到一名目击者正冲过来。

sentences.en: It was Emery Wilson, one of the Faith's neighbours.
sentences.zh: 那是埃默里·威尔逊，费斯家的一位邻居。

sentences.en: Emery approached Darren and the two made eye contact.
sentences.zh: 埃默里走近达伦，两人对视了一眼。

sentences.en: Darren was carrying extra ammo and could have killed Emery to protect his own identity, but he maintained his mission of not wanting any collateral damage.
sentences.zh: 达伦身上带着额外的弹药，本可以为了保护身份杀掉埃默里，但他坚持不造成附带伤害的任务原则。

sentences.en: Once Emery ran off, Darren got back into his truck.
sentences.zh: 埃默里跑开后，达伦回到了他的卡车上。

sentences.en: The commotion had drawn several more neighbours onto the street, so Darren drove off slowly, not wanting to accidentally run any of them down.
sentences.zh: 骚乱引来了更多邻居到街上，所以达伦慢慢开车离开，不想意外撞到任何人。

sentences.en: Darren wasn't happy about what he'd done, but was nevertheless satisfied that he'd accomplished his mission.
sentences.zh: 达伦对自己所做的事并不高兴，但仍然对完成了任务感到满足。

sentences.en: On the long drive home, he tossed Jamie's wedding ring out the window.
sentences.zh: 在回家的长途车程中，他把杰米的结婚戒指扔出了窗外。

sentences.en: He didn't get rid of the murder weapon because he wanted to make sure it was never used to hurt another person again.
sentences.zh: 他没有处理掉凶器，因为他想确保它永远不会再被用来伤害别人。

sentences.en: While Jennifer pretended to be a grieving widow in public, behind closed doors she was elated that Jamie had been killed.
sentences.zh: 虽然詹妮弗在公开场合假装成悲痛的遗孀，但在私下里，她对杰米被杀感到欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: She showered Darren with money, gifts and praise.
sentences.zh: 她用金钱、礼物和赞美来奖励达伦。

sentences.en: When Darren was arrested, he took solace in knowing he had saved Jennifer and her daughter.
sentences.zh: 当达伦被捕时，他因知道自己拯救了詹妮弗和她的女儿而感到一丝安慰。

sentences.en: But that all changed once he finally accepted that Jennifer had duped him.
sentences.zh: 但当他最终接受了詹妮弗欺骗他的事实后，一切都变了。

sentences.en: Darren was devastated to realise he had taken the innocent life of a proud family man.
sentences.zh: 达伦意识到自己夺走了一个自豪的顾家男人的无辜生命，感到万分沮丧。

sentences.en: He was equally shocked that Jennifer would bestow such tragedy on her own daughter.
sentences.zh: 他也同样震惊于詹妮弗竟然会给自己的女儿带来如此悲剧。

sentences.en: He told detectives,
sentences.zh: 他告诉侦探们：

sentences.en: Jennifer turned me into a monster.
sentences.zh: “詹妮弗把我变成了一个恶魔。”

sentences.en: While Jennifer had told countless lies to Darren, he'd only ever lied to her once.
sentences.zh: 虽然詹妮弗对达伦撒了无数谎，但他只对她撒过一次谎。

sentences.en: His military training had taught him to always have an escape route.
sentences.zh: 他的军事训练教导他始终要有一条撤退路线。

sentences.en: He therefore assured
sentences.zh: 因此他向

sentences.en: Jennifer that he'd deleted all of their communications, when in reality he'd kept their emails.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗保证他已经删除了所有的通讯记录，而实际上他保留了他们的邮件。

sentences.en: Following Darren's confession, investigators upgraded the charges against Jennifer Faith from obstruction of justice to murder for hire.
sentences.zh: 在达伦认罪后，调查人员将对詹妮弗·费斯的指控从妨碍司法公正升级为雇凶杀人。

sentences.en: This was a federal offence that carried the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 这是一项联邦罪行，最高可判处死刑。

sentences.en: Jennifer maintained her innocence as she was placed in custody pending trial.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗在被拘留候审期间坚称自己无罪。

sentences.en: A month later, she wrote a letter to her father claiming the prosecution and media had twisted the situation
sentences.zh: 一个月后，她写信给父亲，声称检方和媒体扭曲了事实，

sentences.en: and taken things out of context in order to paint a damning picture against her.
sentences.zh: 断章取义，目的是为了给她抹黑。

sentences.en: Yet, just two days after sending the letter, Jennifer was informed that Darren was cooperating with prosecutors and was willing to testify against her.
sentences.zh: 然而，就在寄出信件两天后，詹妮弗被告知达伦正在与检方合作，并愿意出庭指证她。

sentences.en: This, coupled with the overwhelming evidence, dissuaded Jennifer from taking the case to trial.
sentences.zh: 这一点，加上压倒性的证据，使詹妮弗放弃了进行审判的念头。

sentences.en: In exchange for the death penalty being taken off the table, she agreed to tell the full truth about her husband's murder.
sentences.zh: 作为交换，检方撤销了死刑指控，她同意说出丈夫被杀的全部真相。

sentences.en: Jennifer admitted that Jamie had never been anything other than a wonderful and loving husband.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗承认杰米一直是一个出色且充满爱心的丈夫。

sentences.en: After learning of Darren Lopez's disability, she'd used fake online identities and
sentences.zh: 在得知达伦·洛佩兹的残疾后，她利用虚假的在线身份和

sentences.en: misleading images to convince him that she was being abused by Jamie in the hopes that Darren would be compelled to kill.
sentences.zh: 误导性的图片让他相信自己正受到杰米的虐待，希望达伦能被迫杀人。

sentences.en: After Jamie's death, Jennifer rewarded Darren with gifts and adoration to keep him on her side and prevent him from exposing her involvement.
sentences.zh: 杰米死后，詹妮弗用礼物和爱慕来奖励达伦，以让他站在自己这边，防止他揭露她的参与。

sentences.en: In the words of one US attorney,
sentences.zh: 用一位美国检察官的话说：

sentences.en: Jennifer Faith's conduct both before and after her husband's murder was extraordinarily heinous and cruel.
sentences.zh: “詹妮弗·费斯在丈夫被杀前后的行为极其令人发指和残忍。”

sentences.en: The one person that Jamie Faith loved and trusted more than any other led him to his death.
sentences.zh: 杰米·费斯最爱和最信任的人，却将他引向了死亡。

sentences.en: At
sentences.zh: 在

sentences.en: Jennifer's sentencing in May 2022, the presiding judge criticised her treatment of Darren,
sentences.zh: 2022年5月詹妮弗的量刑听证会上，主审法官批评了她对待达伦的方式，

sentences.en: Darren, stating,
sentences.zh: 达伦，并说道：

sentences.en: He thought he was the only person who could save you.
sentences.zh: “他以为他是唯一能救你的人。”

sentences.en: You tricked him because you thought his brain wasn't working.
sentences.zh: “你欺骗了他，因为你认为他的大脑有问题。”

sentences.en: Jennifer's subsequent attempts to sway law enforcement and public opinion were described as spineless.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗随后试图左右执法部门和公众舆论的行为被描述为毫无骨气。

sentences.en: At one point, Jennifer started to cry.
sentences.zh: 有一次，詹妮弗开始哭泣。

sentences.en: The judge told her,
sentences.zh: 法官对她说：

sentences.en: Mrs. Faith, I'm not sure why you're crying.
sentences.zh: “费斯夫人，我不确定你为什么哭。”

sentences.en: What you did was such a betrayal.
sentences.zh: “你的所作所为是一种背叛。”

sentences.en: You are pure evil.
sentences.zh: “你简直是个恶魔。”

sentences.en: Not to mention, disgusting.
sentences.zh: “更不用说，令人作呕。”

sentences.en: Jennifer Faith was sentenced to life imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·费斯被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: She was also ordered to pay
sentences.zh: 她还被勒令支付

sentences.en: $6,500 in restitution to Jamie's family to cover his unpaid funeral expenses as well as a $250,000 fine.
sentences.zh: 6500美元的赔偿金给杰米的家人，以支付他未付的丧葬费，并处以25万美元罚款。

sentences.en: Outside court, one US attorney remarked,
sentences.zh: 庭外，一位美国检察官评论道：

sentences.en: Jennifer Faith put on quite a performance in the wake of her husband's murder.
sentences.zh: “詹妮弗·费斯在丈夫被杀后演了一场好戏。”

sentences.en: She poured out her sob story to reporters and law enforcement, then headed home to orchestrate her cover-up.
sentences.zh: “她向记者和执法部门倾诉自己的悲惨故事，然后回家策划她的掩盖行动。”

sentences.en: But crocodile tears didn't stop the feds.
sentences.zh: “但鳄鱼的眼泪没能阻止联邦调查局。”

sentences.en: We were committed to getting justice for Jamie, and with the judge's imposition of a life sentence, we're one step closer.
sentences.zh: “我们致力于为杰米伸张正义，随着法官判处终身监禁，我们离目标又近了一步。”

sentences.en: Darren Lopez's murder trial went ahead in July 2023, one year after Jennifer's trial and almost three years after Jamie Faith was murdered.
sentences.zh: 达伦·洛佩兹的谋杀案审判于2023年7月进行，距离詹妮弗的审判过去了一年，距离杰米·费斯被谋杀已近三年。

sentences.en: Given that Darren had already confessed to the killing, it wasn't up to the jury to determine whether he was guilty of murder per se.
sentences.zh: 鉴于达伦已经承认杀人，陪审团的任务不是确定他是否犯有谋杀罪本身。

sentences.en: They just had to consider the degree of his culpability, and whether a lesser charge like manslaughter was more applicable.
sentences.zh: 他们只需要考虑他的罪责程度，以及是否适用过失杀人等较轻的指控。

sentences.en: In their opening statements, the defence told the jury that what they were about to hear was
sentences.zh: 在开庭陈述中，辩方告诉陪审团，他们即将听到的是

sentences.en: one of the most heart-wrenching and tragic cases anybody's ever heard in this courthouse.
sentences.zh: “本法院听过的最令人心碎和悲惨的案件之一。”

sentences.en: While Jennifer Faith wasn't on trial, the defence asserted that she was the real guilty person in this scenario.
sentences.zh: 虽然詹妮弗·费斯没有受审，但辩方断言她是这个剧本中真正的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: The crux of their case was that Jennifer had taken advantage of Darren Lopez's disability as well as his feelings for her, which meant she knew which buttons to push.
sentences.zh: 他们案件的核心是，詹妮弗利用了达伦·洛佩兹的残疾以及他对她的感情，这意味着她知道如何操纵他。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用：

sentences.en: Darren pulled the trigger, but Jennifer pulled him.
sentences.zh: “达伦扣动了扳机，但詹妮弗拉动了他。”

sentences.en: Given Darren's past trauma, the defence argued that he viewed danger differently than the average person, and therefore he genuinely believed that Jennifer's
sentences.zh: 鉴于达伦过去的创伤，辩方辩称他看待危险的方式与普通人不同，因此他真诚地相信詹妮弗的

sentences.en: life was in immediate danger, which required necessary action.
sentences.zh: 生命处于迫在眉睫的危险之中，这需要采取必要的行动。

sentences.en: In their opinion, what Darren did amounted to self-defence.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，达伦的行为等同于自卫。

sentences.en: The prosecution called this idea absurd and unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 检方称这种想法荒谬且不可信。

sentences.en: Texas law dictates that an individual can only be justified in using force against another if they
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州法律规定，个人只有在以下情况下使用武力对付他人才是正当的：

sentences.en: reasonably believe the force is immediately necessary to protect themselves in the face of imminent harm.
sentences.zh: 他们合理地认为，面对迫在眉睫的伤害，为了保护自己，这种武力是立即必要的。

sentences.en: But, as the prosecution argued, there was nothing immediate about what Darren did.
sentences.zh: 但是，正如检方所辩称的那样，达伦所做的一切绝非“迫在眉睫”。

sentences.en: From the day Jennifer had first confided in Darren about the alleged abuse, 186 days passed before Jamie was killed.
sentences.zh: 从詹妮弗第一次向达伦吐露所谓的虐待之日起，过了186天杰米才被杀。

sentences.en: Darren therefore had plenty of time to consider other, less drastic options.
sentences.zh: 因此，达伦有充足的时间考虑其他不那么极端的选择。

sentences.en: He could have reached out to
sentences.zh: 他本可以联系

sentences.en: Jennifer's family, contacted Jamie's employer, alerted the authorities, or helped Jennifer escape.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗的家人，联系杰米的雇主，报警，或者帮助詹妮弗逃跑。

sentences.en: After all, he had the special forces training needed to conduct an escape mission without taking any casualties.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他拥有执行逃生任务所需的特种部队训练，且无需造成任何伤亡。

sentences.en: Darren had considered all of these options in his emails to Jennifer, but the prosecution argued that he glossed right over them.
sentences.zh: 达伦在给詹妮弗的邮件中考虑过所有这些选择，但检方认为他直接忽略了它们。

sentences.en: Instead, all he did was email Rob Schmidt, a man he'd never met.
sentences.zh: 相反，他所做的只是给罗伯·施密特发了封邮件，一个他从未见过的人。

sentences.en: When Rob didn't do anything, Darren skipped all the other options and jumped straight to murder.
sentences.zh: 当罗伯没有采取任何行动时，达伦跳过了所有其他选择，直接跳到了谋杀。

sentences.en: It took him ten hours to drive to Dallas, at which point he laid in wait for five hours before ambushing Jamie Faith.
sentences.zh: 他花了十个小时开车到达拉斯，然后埋伏了五个小时，才伏击了杰米·费斯。

sentences.en: The prosecution asked,
sentences.zh: 检方问道：

sentences.en: What is immediate about that?
sentences.zh: “那有什么迫在眉睫的？”

sentences.en: It has to be immediate.
sentences.zh: “它必须是迫在眉睫的。”

sentences.en: That means now, right this moment, action is needed.
sentences.zh: “这意味着现在，就在这一刻，需要采取行动。”

sentences.en: Not in a few minutes, not in a few hours, not later today, not this weekend.
sentences.zh: “不是几分钟后，不是几小时后，不是今天晚些时候，也不是这个周末。”

sentences.en: Right now, a split second decision.
sentences.zh: “就在现在，一个瞬间的决定。”

sentences.en: Fear of future danger is never enough, and certainly when you have premeditated an execution, there is nothing immediate about it.
sentences.zh: “对未来危险的恐惧永远不够，尤其是当你预谋了一场处决时，这绝非迫在眉睫。”

sentences.en: When Darren did act, the prosecution highlighted that Jamie was unarmed, unsuspecting, and had done nothing to provoke Darren.
sentences.zh: 当达伦采取行动时，检方强调杰米当时手无寸铁、毫无防备，且并未对达伦有任何挑衅行为。

sentences.en: Darren was trained in situational awareness and assessing threats, yet he killed Jamie when he was innocently walking past with his dog and with his wife.
sentences.zh: 达伦受过情境意识和威胁评估方面的训练，但他却杀害了当时正与妻子和爱犬无辜路过的杰米。

sentences.en: His use of force was therefore unnecessary.
sentences.zh: 因此，他使用武力的行为是不必要的。

sentences.en: The prosecution stated,
sentences.zh: 检方陈述道：

sentences.en: The defendant talked a lot about honour.
sentences.zh: 被告谈论了很多关于荣誉的话题。

sentences.en: There was no honour in this.
sentences.zh: 但这其中毫无荣誉可言。

sentences.en: This was the most dishonourable thing that a man can do.
sentences.zh: 这是一个人所能做的最不光彩的事情。

sentences.en: They argued that even if Darren had been completely misled, it still didn't justify him committing murder.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，即使达伦完全被误导了，这也不能成为他实施谋杀的理由。

sentences.en: As an elite special forces soldier, Darren was well equipped to conduct reconnaissance to confirm if Jennifer really was being abused.
sentences.zh: 作为一名精英特种部队士兵，达伦完全有能力进行侦察，以确认詹妮弗是否真的受到了虐待。

sentences.en: Not only did he fail to do so, he also knew that Jamie was a tech whiz who worked for one of the most regulated industries on earth.
sentences.zh: 他不仅没有这样做，而且他还知道杰米是一位技术专家，在世界上监管最严的行业之一工作。

sentences.zh: 检方认为，这些通讯记录中包含了两人早在2020年10月之前就密谋除掉杰米的证据。

sentences.zh: 审判结束后，一名陪审员在接受美国全国广播公司新闻频道匿名采访时透露，他们都一致认为，正是因为达伦的行为，才导致了一个无辜的人死亡。

sentences.en: What they couldn't agree on was the level of punishment he deserved.
sentences.zh: 他们无法达成一致的是他应受到的惩罚程度。

sentences.en: Regardless of Jennifer's deceit, the donors regretted nothing.

sentences.en: One said, I would do it again if I thought that a neighbour was in need because that's who we are and we're not going to change because somebody was awful.

sentences.zh: 事实证明，有些人从一开始就对詹妮弗的行为感到怀疑。

sentences.en: Some thought it was strange that Jamie's killer had spared Jennifer's life despite her being a witness to their crimes.
sentences.zh: 有些人觉得奇怪，杰米的杀手在詹妮弗目睹了他们的罪行后，竟然放过了她。

sentences.en: Others immediately thought the shooting had all the hallmarks of a hired hit.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则立即认为这次枪击事件具有雇凶杀人的所有特征。

sentences.en: Those close to the Faiths also found it odd that soon after Jamie's murder, Jennifer cropped Jamie out of her existing profile picture on social media.
sentences.zh: 与费思一家关系密切的人也觉得奇怪，在杰米遇害后不久，詹妮弗就将杰米从她现有的社交媒体头像中裁剪掉了。

sentences.en: After Jamie's death, Emery was one of the supporters who put his own anxieties aside to accompany Jennifer as she walked her dog.

sentences.zh: 此前不知道这一事实的她，突然问埃默里那个人看起来是黑人还是拉美裔。

sentences.zh: 詹妮弗没有再追问埃默里，这让埃默里觉得很奇怪。

sentences.en: He thought she would want to learn all she could to help identify her husband's killer.

sentences.zh: 杰米·费思的去世对他所爱的人产生了深远的影响。

sentences.en: A friend of his told ABC News.
sentences.zh: 他的一位朋友告诉美国广播公司新闻频道：

sentences.en: I just miss my friend.
sentences.zh: 我只是想念我的朋友。
